scope: Acquisition, declarative contracts and data alignment; application/i18n realization belongs to OffMenu i18n task
schemaEvolution: Every newly acquired field/type must map to the common resource/assertion/value/relation contract. Preserve typed unmapped source facts, original locators, vocabulary/measurement definitions and type proposals; register extensions with evidence before semantic qualification. No field dropped merely because a current consumer lacks support.
identityPolicy: Source variants remain distinct. Candidate concept links, ingredient matches and quantities require review; no recipe averaging, new worked recipe, nutrient equivalence or dietary eligibility is inferred.
translationPolicy: Stable identities, source hashes, RDF/XML expressions and quantity dimensions remain fixed. Display text carries language and citation. A translation references its exact source-text hash; source edition language never constrains the target language or identifies country.

publicationPrivacy.sourceRights: Per-citation licence, attribution and rights scope retained; imported FoodOn classes remain references.

tests.wholePackage: 79,534 packets checked against schema; resource/assertion/relation identity uniqueness, citation resolution and public scope checked
tests.publishedData: 170 files and both native recipe downloads fully read back; bytes/hashes/counts checked; base 22,519,902 records unchanged
tests.recipeConsumer: All 25,135 recipes exercised through stock matching/portable export; all 256 incomplete OCR candidates withheld from planning and personal conversion

limits: Entire 20-source corpus is declaratively mapped; full resource graphs in this package cover recipes, ingredient terminology and FoodOn. Remaining legacy source records are not falsely claimed migrated. Translation UI, reviewed cross-source synthesis and application migration are the implementing agent’s work.
